messages.subject: For Blake Moret | Industrial transformation, sustainability and government relations
messages.body:
Dear Rockwell Automation Team,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Blake Moret, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer.

Rockwell Automation's role in industrial transformation increasingly sits at the intersection of technology, sustainability, customers, governments and regulated operating environments. Those priorities align closely with my current mandate.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My responsibilities span government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory. I also support stakeholder governance around a large industrial renewable-energy platform and coordinated a carbon-accounting evidence pilot using operating data.

I would welcome a senior conversation about where this combination of sustainability, government relations and industrial operating experience might support Rockwell Automation's priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to Rockwell Automation.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
